title: You Never Even Call Me By My Name

sections.label: Intro
lines: Well it was all that I could do to keep from cryin'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sometimes it seemed so useless to remain
But you don't have to call me darlin' darlin'
You never even call me by my name

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: You don't have to call me Waylon Jennings
And you don't have to call me Charley Pride
And you don't have to call me Merle Haggard anymore
Even though you're on my fightin' side

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: And I'll hang around as long as you will let me
and I never minded standing in the rain
But you don't have to call me darlin' darlin'
You never even call me by my name

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Well I've heard my name a few times in your phonebook (hello hello)
And I've seen it on signs where I've played
But the only time I know I'll hear David Allan Coe
Is when Jesus has his final judgement day

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: And I'll hang around as long as you will let me
and I never minded standing in the rain
But you don't have to call me darlin' darlin'
You never even call me by my name

sections.label: Speech
lines: Well a friend of mine named Steve Goodman wrote that song
And he told me it was the perfect country and western song.
I wrote him back a letter and told him it was not the perfect
country and western song because he hadn't said anything at all
about mama, or trains, or trucks, or prison, or gettin drunk.
well he sat down and wrote another verse to the song and he sent it to me
and after readin' it I realized my friend had written the perfect
country and western song, and I felt obliged to included on this album.
The last verse goes like this here

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Well I was drunk the day my mom got out of prison
And I went to pick her up in the rain
But before I could get to the station in a pickup truck
She got run over by a damned ol' train

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: And I'll hang around as long as you will let me
and I never minded standing in the rain
But you don't have to call me darlin' darlin'
You never even call me
Well I wonder why you don't call me
Why don't you ever call me by my name?
